QuestInfo.name: Destroying the Power of Evil
QuestInfo.0: Dark Tachion is an altered version of Tachion, which is the source of power that forms the Time Sphere. It should be deemed dangerous now, and since a creepy, evil force keeps seeping out of it, it must be a dangerous time here. I should destroy this at the lava deep in El Nath.
QuestInfo.1: After taking care of Papulatus, it coughed up Dark Tachion, emitting a dark force in the process. To destroy this, I went to the deepest part of El Nath where the lava flows. I better destroy this by dropping it in the boiling lava.
QuestInfo.2: After entering a hidden area where the lava flows, I found a Suspicious Lava. This is where I threw the Dark Tachion to destroy it. The force of evil disappeared along with the Tachion itself.

0.0: The scorching hot lava is leaving hot tracks everywhere, and it seems to be very hot around it. Walking up to it, I can feel the scorching heat gripping my skin. I'll have to drop the Dark Tachion here in order to destroy the force of evil once and for all!

yes.0: I should re-observe the lava and prepare myself to destroy the Dark Tachion, the one that contains the evil force of Papulatus.

1.0: Will you destroy all the Dark Tachions that you possess in your inventory?

yes.0: Every Dark Tachion around has been destroyed, and all the evil forces that accompany with them have been decimated.

item.0: You do not have the Dark Tachion necessary to dump in the lava.
